title: Christmas elf returns from the North Pole in a fresh new outfit
description: This family's Christmas elf had worn right through his old outfit. We kept his original face and moved his head onto a matching replacement body, so he could come home looking like himself, as if he had just picked up new clothes at the North Pole.
itemDetails: This is a poseable Christmas elf doll with a moulded plastic face, pointed ears and painted features. He wears a black felt-style hat and suit, a grey star-shaped collar, a belt with a silver-coloured buckle, and long grey and black striped legs. No brand label is visible in the repair photos, so the exact maker and model have not been identified.
repairDetails: The client brought in two elves: their well-loved original and a matching replacement. The original's body and outfit were badly worn, but his face was the one the family knew. So the original head was carefully separated from the old body and fitted onto the replacement body. The neck join was secured and the collar settled back into place, keeping the familiar face on a clean, sturdy new outfit. As far as the family's little one knows, he simply needed to change out of his old clothes at the North Pole.
